messages.subject: Ubuntu Karmic Koala & R version 2.9.2 (2009-08-24)
messages.body_plain:
Hi there,

I'm getting an error when I try installing Reducer. It seems than JGR
package is missing in official repos... apparently not due to system
incompatibility, but rather to version of R... But I'm running R
version 2.9.2, which is default in Ubuntu repositories, and not
version 2.10.0

When I try starting Deducer, I get this message:

> require(Deducer)
Loading required package: Deducer
Warning message:
In library(package, lib.loc = lib.loc, character.only = TRUE,
logical.return = TRUE,  :
  there is no package called 'Deducer'

or this one (completely redundant info, but, hey, who knows...):

> library(Deducer)
Error in library(Deducer) : there is no package called 'Deducer'

Any suggestions?! I reckon that this is the one of those sit-and-wait
problems? Right?!?

messages.subject: Re: Ubuntu Karmic Koala & R version 2.9.2 (2009-08-24)
messages.body_plain:
The latest version of JGR (1.7) requires R 2.10.0 due to the new
dynamic help system. I'll be updating Deducer to run with this very
soon, so you will need to upgrade. Everything should be sorted out in
a week or two. In the mean time, after you have upgraded, you can
install from the development repository using:

install.packages(c("rJava","JGR","Deducer"),,"http://www.rforge.net",type="source")

Ian
